tasks.subject: [official-community-space] [P1] Add open admission, auto-join channels and bans to the Community server
tasks.description:
Read specs/official-community-space/02-specification.md first; the decision numbers (D1..D14) are binding. Implements D1, D2, D3 and the ban half of D6 in apps/community.
- Migration: admissionPolicy gains 'open' (schema.ts:34 and its check at :72-75); channels.auto_join boolean default false; new bans table (community_id, user_id, email_hash, reason, actor_member_id, created_at, lifted_at) with an index on (community_id, user_id) and (community_id, email_hash).
- Open join: a route for 'open' communities that admits a signed-in person with a verified email, reusing the redeem transaction in routes/community/invites.ts:434-570 (community lock, member cap via host/limits.ts, handle minting, reactivation, audit 'member.admit' with origin 'open'). The sign-up gate in auth.ts:64-105/202-208 must admit a sign-up that targets an open community (a short-lived admission cookie, like invites' preflight).
- Auto-join: every admission path (invite, open, owner claim) adds the person to every public auto_join channel.
- Ban: owner/admin ban + unban routes (admin cannot ban an admin or the owner); ban removes the member through the existing removal path (members.ts) and refuses invite preflight/redeem, open join, pairing start and sign-in-to-community for that user or verified-email hash. Audited.
- Settings route accepts 'open' (administration.ts) and channels accept auto_join.
- Wire types in packages/shared/src/community-wire.ts; conformance capability flags in packages/test-utils/src/community-conformance.ts if the adapter surface changes.
- Space web UI (apps/community/src/browser): a join page for open spaces; ban/unban in member management.
Acceptance: Postgres integration tests for open join (verified vs unverified email, member cap, auto-join channels), ban blocking every admission path and rejoin with a new account on the same email, admin-cannot-ban-admin; pnpm --filter @dorkos/community typecheck/lint/test and the pg suite pass; changelog fragment.
Review additions (binding):
- Open join only through the host's configured single sign-on callback (isOidcCallback in auth.ts); never a password sign-up. Per-IP and per-host open-join rate limits (limits/attempt-limiter.ts) and a host switch COMMUNITY_OPEN_ADMISSION=0 that refuses every open join.
- Ban email key: normalise (lowercase; strip +tag; Gmail dots) then HMAC with the auth secret; never an unsalted hash.
- The admin wire enum CommunityAdminAdmissionPolicySchema in packages/shared/src/community-admin-wire.ts:18 must gain 'open'. That file is read by the private host operator, so open a GitHub issue labelled cloud-contract and land the contract change first, additively.
- bans and channels.auto_join join export (exports/collections.ts), import (imports/v2-*), erasure (erasure/), takedown and deletion-worker.ts, with tests.

tasks.subject: [official-community-space] [P1] Pin stranger safety for space messages end to end in the app
tasks.description:
Read specs/official-community-space/02-specification.md first; the decision numbers (D1..D14) are binding. Implements D9 and D10 in apps/server.
- Tests that walk a mirrored space entry from RemoteRoomSubscriptionBridge.importLive (services/communities/remote/remote-room-subscription-bridge.ts) through RoomService.dispatchImportedRemoteEntry, isEntryAuthorExternal (services/rooms/room-trigger.ts:571) and room-turn-runner.ts:641-646/890 to permissionSeedForOrigin === 'none' (services/session/origin/turn-origin.ts:215).
- Pin that no automatic path (operator unattended level, the DOR-2739 trusted preset, configured-stop-on-insert) raises a space room's session.
- Pin: a remote agent's entry never dispatches; a stranger cannot enroll, eject or spoof an enrolled local agent (local-agent-authority.ts).
- Fix: space mirror rooms get the outsider framing in the room context (room-core.ts:216-219 bridgedFraming only checks chat bridges; room-context.ts:199-206).
- New per-connection setting wakeAgentsFrom: 'me' | 'members' on the remote connection record (connection-store.ts), default 'members' (official default comes in 2.2). With 'me' only an entry whose remote author is this install's own owner member wakes an agent. Owner-only route to change it.
- Mutation check: for each new test, remove its guard locally and confirm it fails; list the results in the PR body.
Acceptance: tests pass; outsider-framing visible in room context for a space room; changelog fragment.
Review additions (binding):
- The real gap: externalAuthor is only checked when the session is NEW (room-turn-runner.ts:629-650). Implement a per-turn stranger ceiling: every turn whose trigger is external runs at the mode that asks (or dontAsk when the agent is set lower) whatever the session row holds. Test "owner mentions first (row born at configured stop), stranger mentions second" and assert the stranger turn runs at the ceiling.
- wakeAgentsFrom is operator-only: register it in config-write-policy / default-verdicts the way DOR-2740 did for spaces.enabled (or the equivalent owner-only route check), with a test that an agent cannot change it.

tasks.subject: [official-community-space] [P1] Make Community live streams scale with LISTEN/NOTIFY fan-out
tasks.description:
Read specs/official-community-space/02-specification.md first; the decision numbers (D1..D14) are binding. Implements D12 and the server half of D13 in apps/community.
- Today each GET /channels/:id/events stream (routes/community/events.ts:231-520) polls access every 250 ms and the next entry every 250 ms through a 12-connection pool (main.ts:48-50). Replace with: one dedicated LISTEN connection; entry insert/removal/redaction and membership/ban/mute changes NOTIFY on a channel keyed by community/channel; an in-process hub wakes only the affected streams, which read once. Access decisions cached per (stream, member) and invalidated by membership/ban/mute notices; a 15 s fallback poll catches a lost notice; LISTEN reconnect re-reads every stream once.
- Config (config.ts): pool size, per-process stream cap (past it: 503 with Retry-After), fallback interval.
- /health/ready checks a database round trip; /health stays a liveness probe.
- /metrics in Prometheus text, requiring a host API key with a read scope: open streams, posts per minute, joins per minute, pool waiting count, notice-to-delivery lag.
- Keep the single-machine rule (FLY.md:83); no cross-process fan-out.
Acceptance: pg integration tests (two streams one notice both wake; dropped notice recovered by fallback; revoked access ends the stream promptly; cap answers 503); existing events tests pass; changelog fragment.
Review additions (binding):
- Invalidate cached access on EVERY revocation source the 250 ms assertPrincipalCurrent check covers today (data.ts:328-390): session revocation, grant and agent-credential revocation, community lifecycle (held, suspended, takedown, deletion), channel archive and epoch change, agent deactivation, plus bans and mutes. A test per source proves the stream ends promptly.
- LISTEN on a direct (unpooled) connection: COMMUNITY_LISTEN_DATABASE_URL defaulting to the main URL; a NOTIFY self-test at boot; listener health in /health/ready and /metrics; ids-only payloads (8 kB NOTIFY cap); re-read every stream on reconnect.
- A per-community stream quota beside the per-process cap, so one community's spike cannot shut out the rest of the host. Note FLY.md already requires the direct URL; document the listener URL there.

tasks.subject: [official-community-space] [P2] Add mute, slow mode, reports, rules and display names to the Community server
tasks.description:
Read specs/official-community-space/02-specification.md first; the decision numbers (D1..D14) are binding. Implements the rest of D6, D7 and D8 in apps/community. Depends on 1.1 (same migration chain).
- Mute: members.muted_until; owner/admin set/clear with a duration; a muted person and their agents get 403 COMMUNITY_MUTED with the end time on post.
- Slow mode: channels.slow_mode_seconds; per-person last post time; owner/admin exempt; 429 COMMUNITY_SLOW_MODE with retry-after on post.
- Reports: reports table (community, entry, reporter member, reason enum + note, status open/actioned/dismissed, resolver, times). Any member reports an entry once; owner/admin list the queue and resolve with remove-message / mute / ban / dismiss, each audited.
- Rules: community rules text + version; members.rules_accepted_version; posting before accepting the current version answers 403 COMMUNITY_RULES_NOT_ACCEPTED; accept route.
- Display name: member self-update with the same validation as sign-up.
- Wire types, adapter + conformance flags, and the space web UI (moderation queue, rules editor and acceptance, mute and slow-mode controls).
Acceptance: pg integration tests per feature including agent posts under a muted owner; changelog fragment.
Review additions (binding):
- An agent's post needs its owner to have accepted the current rules, and a muted owner's agents cannot post.
- Display name: refuse owner-reserved names (a community setting) and the handles/names of the community's agents.
- New tables/columns (reports, mutes, slow mode, rules acceptance) join export, import, erasure, takedown and the deletion worker.
- If the admin wire changes, the same cloud-contract-first rule as 1.1 applies.

tasks.subject: [official-community-space] [P2] Let the official space through the spaces switch and offer it at onboarding
tasks.description:
Read specs/official-community-space/02-specification.md first; the decision numbers (D1..D14) are binding. Implements D4, D5 and the app half of D13. Depends on DOR-2740 merging (session 6baaf5dc; its middleware is apps/server/src/middleware/spaces-enabled.ts).
- Config spaces.official.url (default '' until Dorian supplies the link), env DORKOS_OFFICIAL_SPACE_URL, semver-keyed migration (adding-config-fields skill).
- Connection record gains official: true, set only in pairing-service start() when the started link equals the configured link and discovery resolves to the same origin + community id.
- spaceReachable(ref) replaces whole-feature checks: per-:ref gates in remote-communities and community-connections routers; while off, list returns only the official row, start pairing only from the official link, /api/cloud/communities/sign-in only for the official origin; bridge dispatchEnabled takes the ref. Official connection defaults wakeAgentsFrom 'me' (from 1.2).
- Client useSpaceVisible(ref): the official row shows in the switcher with the experiment off; other spaces, Start and hosting stay hidden. A calm unreachable state for the official space.
- Onboarding step "Join the DorkOS community" (features/onboarding) and a prompt after linking a DorkOS account, using the account sign-in hint (entities/community/model/use-account-sign-in.ts). Skippable, never repeated after a skip.
Acceptance: route tests with the experiment on/off; client tests; one e2e journey on the test-mode server; app copy per writing-app-copy; changelog fragment.
Review additions (binding):
- spaces.official.url and the official connection's settings are operator-only (config-write-policy / default-verdicts), with a test that an agent's config_patch is refused.
- Never store official: true. Store the origin and community id discovery returned at pairing and compute official on every read against current config.
- Router-param middleware for :ref (DOR-2740 gates at router level in app.ts and cloud.ts). Routes without a :ref also need an answer while off: the connection list, the global SSE stream, /api/rooms contributions, room MCP tools on mirror rooms and the outbox.

tasks.subject: [official-community-space] [P3] Let our agents host the space
tasks.description:
Read specs/official-community-space/02-specification.md first; the decision numbers (D1..D14) are binding. Implements D11. Depends on 2.2.
- Per-connection answerIn: string[] (channel names); every fresh human post in those channels wakes the enrolled host agent without a mention, still seeded 'none'.
- An agent set to dontAsk keeps dontAsk on stranger turns (pin with a test).
- Host agent persona (greets in #welcome, answers in #help, points to docs, never promises features that are not shipped) as a template file, plus contributing/official-community-host.md: setting up the staff install, enrolling the host agent, docs read-only access, answerIn, and what to watch.
Acceptance: tests for answerIn and the dontAsk ceiling; runbook; changelog fragment.
Review additions (binding):
- The staff install holds a plain member seat, never admin.
- answerIn must get past the bridge's mentions.length early return (remote-room-subscription-bridge.ts ~:188) without loosening it for other connections.
- A wake budget per author and per channel for answerIn wakes (a flood cannot buy unlimited turns), with tests.
- The runbook lists the exact tool allowlist for the host agent.
